items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995
items.q: Al asked me to talk to you about one night

ctx.x: You’ve got to stay hungry. Yeah. Never know it all.

Do you have a funny little story about the Basie band that you could leave us with? Or anything that happened? Al asked me to talk to you about one night that you and another player got lost or got left behind or something on a trip?
